name: Číměř (Jindřichův Hradec District, Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and yellow in the ratio 1:2:1.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 28 November 2000 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
